title: Steering Intensity Calibration Across Model Sizes

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Understanding the optimal steering magnitude at each scale informs deployment. Useful but the impact chain is indirect: calibration guidance rather than a new defense capability.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires running four model sizes (1B through 70B) and varying steering magnitudes at each. The 70B model alone exceeds medium compute. Multiple model sizes multiply the experimental effort.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Four model sizes times multiple steering magnitudes creates a large experimental matrix. Pareto frontier computation requires many evaluation points. Far too broad for 30 hours.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
